newsitem.title: USA: Chicago exchanges hail Lugar-Leahy futures bill.
newsitem.headline: Chicago exchanges hail Lugar-Leahy futures bill.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade and Chicago Mercantile Exchange hailed a bill introduced by Senators Richard Lugar and Patrick Leahy on Monday to reform the Commodity Exchange Act.

"While we still have serious concerns, this legislation moves us another step closer to removing anti-competitive government regulations which inhibit the Chicago Board of Trade and other U.S. futures exchanges from responding to our customers' needs," CBOT chairman Patrick Arbor said in a statement.
